bio.text: Linda Sánchez, a Democrat, has represented California in the U.S. House of Representatives since 2003; she currently represents the 38th District and is the Democratic candidate in California's 41st Congressional District in 2026.
Her House website says she was elected in 2002, is a former labor lawyer, and is ranking member of the Ways and Means Trade Subcommittee.
She was born in Orange, California, and earned a bachelor's degree in Spanish literature from the University of California, Berkeley, and a J.D. from UCLA in 1995.
